name: What is the difference between solid wood and composite bathroom door frames?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between solid wood and composite bathroom door frames?

acceptedAnswer.text: Solid wood offers classic beauty and easy custom sizing, but composite and PVC jambs provide superior resistance to bathroom water and steam. Solid pine or poplar frames work well if thoroughly primed on all six sides, but they remain vulnerable if standing water reaches an unsealed cut end. Composite materials like poly-fiber or PVC do not absorb water, crack, or rot, making them ideal for high-humidity bathrooms. The tradeoff is that composite frames cost slightly more upfront and can be more flexible, requiring precise shimming during installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Solid wood is traditional and rigid but prone to moisture rot, whereas composite and PVC frames resist moisture and mold completely, making them ideal for bathrooms.
